profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full-stack developer who enjoys figuring out tough problems with code and cloud stuff. I got into tech digging through a "graveyard" of old computer parts as a kid. I never got one booted, but it sparked a curiosity that remains with me today.

I work with React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, Go, and platforms like AWS and GCP, building apps for industries  eCommerce and SaaS. I’ve built projects from the ground up, speeding up frontends, making them user-friendly, and setting up strong backends with SQL and NoSQL.

Freelancing taught me to adapt fast, and support gigs made me better at keeping things clear and simple. I love working with a team, sharing what I know, and making stuff that lasts.

If you’re working on something interesting, let’s chat—I’d love to hear about it and maybe help out!
